description: Reusable self-authored question templates for AWS Certification Coach generation.

prompt_variants: A team is reviewing an AWS design and needs a solution that can {purpose}. Which AWS service or feature should they choose?
During exam preparation, explain which AWS service or feature is best suited to {purpose}.
An AWS workload must {purpose}. Identify the most appropriate service or feature and explain why.
Which AWS capability best meets a requirement to {purpose}? Explain the selection.
templates.question_pattern: Explain which AWS service or feature should be used to {purpose}.
